Class ResponseAssert

java.lang.Object
forj.http.testing.ResponseAssert
public final class ResponseAssert extends Object
Fluent checks on a Response, failing with AssertionError, so they work under any test framework. The body is read once and kept, so a streamed body can be checked more than once.
